purpose: This module runs two sequential passes over badminton commentary chunk sidecars. The clean pass uses Gemini LLM to remove transcription noise and generate paraphrases, validated by BERTScore. The fine-timestamp pass uses WhisperX on GPU to snap coarse timestamps to word boundaries.

public_api.name: CleanError
public_api.role: Exception raised when LLM clean calls fail after exhausting retries; signals log-and-skip to the caller.

public_api.name: call_clean_llm
public_api.role: Calls Gemini with exponential backoff retry to clean one commentary chunk and generate paraphrases; used internally by run_clean and in tests via monkeypatch.

public_api.name: run_clean
public_api.role: Main entry point for the LLM clean+paraphrase pass; processes all kept videos, calls LLM per chunk, validates via BERTScore, marks pass/fail, and rewrites chunk sidecars.

public_api.name: load_fine_models
public_api.role: Loads WhisperX and alignment models once for the entire run on GPU; returns None if WhisperX/torch missing or CUDA unavailable; used by run_fine to avoid per-video VRAM leaks.

public_api.name: refine_timestamps
public_api.role: Re-aligns padded audio spans of each chunk with WhisperX and snaps start/end to word boundaries; mutates chunks in place; called per video by run_fine.

public_api.name: run_fine
public_api.role: Main entry point for the WhisperX fine-timestamp pass; processes all kept videos, extracts audio spans, calls refine_timestamps, and cleans up GPU memory.

public_api.name: main
public_api.role: CLI entry point with flags to run clean-only, fine-only, force re-clean, and specify video directory for fine pass.
